# WildBionics

> WildBionics is a bilingual (English/German) open-source compendium that connects biology with physics, mathematics, chemistry, computer science and Physical AI (embodied, robotic AI) – through animals, plants, geology and bionics. Its time axis runs from the Big Bang to humanoid robots and the open question of superintelligence. Every article views one natural phenomenon through several "lenses" (biology, physics, mathematics, computer science) and cites peer-reviewed sources with DOIs.

- Content licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 – reuse is welcome with attribution to "WildBionics ({{ site.url }})".
- Code licence: MIT. Source and issue tracker: {{ site.repository_url }}
- English lives at the site root, German under /de/. Translations share a `ref` and are linked with hreflang.
- Maintainer: {{ site.author.name }} ({{ site.author.url }})
